title: Share users through Axum State
summary: Hand shared state over with with_state, panic on the 0.7 path syntax, and fix it to {id}.

turns.user: list_users only ever returns []. keep some users in memory for now. also a /users/:id that gets one

assistant.body: Here's the plan. AppState goes into the Router with with_state, and each handler takes it through State. The Arc<RwLock<HashMap>> is the single source of truth for users.

turns.user: panics the moment it starts. something about Path segments must not start with `:`

assistant.body: Apologies, that route used the axum 0.7 syntax. Since 0.8 a path parameter is written in braces as {id}, and :id panics as soon as the Router is built. One line to fix.

turns.user: works. oh can the list come back in id order? its random every time

assistant.body: Sure. Swapping HashMap for BTreeMap. A BTreeMap iterates in key order, so values() comes out sorted by id. The same substitution fixes the use line.
